capabilities: Encrypt file contents and file names with a passphrase
Merge non-overlapping edits and write conflict copies
Keep replaced file versions on the server for 30 days
Share a vault with invited users
extras: Paid plan is bought outside the plugin through a Telegram bot; sync only runs while the app is open; a forgotten passphrase makes synced data unrecoverable; the plugin is MIT-licensed but the server implementation is closed-source and a self-hosting guide is only planned.
motivation: Built for people priced out of other options: twice the storage per dollar, and you can pay with a bank card, crypto, or rubles.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices normally means wiring up storage buckets, servers or Git, and hosted options can be expensive or hard to pay for in some regions.

relations.evidence: get a login code from our Telegram bot
transfers encrypted file data directly to Cloudflare R2 object storage via short-lived signed URLs

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync and backup that uploads encrypted files to remote storage, merges concurrent edits and shares vaults.
